case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hello Claudia,

Thank you for your quick and clear offer. We appreciate the practical approach.

To be open with you, we are comparing offers for this part:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

We would still like to find a way to work with you. Both options below are genuine; the second gives you a longer payment term in exchange for a marginally higher price:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 13.98; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.03; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thanks for being open about the other offer; we really want to run these parts for you. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We can do the DAP delivery you asked for, and to beat your other guy I'm dropping the price to 15.70 EUR. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. We have free capacity for your parts. 

So our Angebot is a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our Lieferzeit is 28 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hello Claudia,

Thank you for the revised Angebot and for confirming that the DAP delivery works for you. We appreciate your openness and your wish to run these parts for us.

We understand that you need to clarify things internally. To make that easier, here are our two options for you to take to your decision:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.12; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.19; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Both options give you a longer payment term, which answers your wish for faster cash. We are firm on price, but happy to meet you on these other terms.

Best regards

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. 

Hallo, a longer payment term actually means slower cash for us, not faster! We really need to stick to 30 days net. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. To make a deal, I'll drop the price to 14.90 EUR if we keep the 30 days payment. 

Our current offer is a price of €14.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. 

Let's get this sorted so we can start turning your parts. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
